title: Current-tree AC1024 CLASSES high-bit string-size recheck

formatAuthority.finding: The CLASSES section declares a byte-sized class-data area and total class-data bit count, then class records and a Unicode string stream. The reader shares the R2007+ string-stream footer rule that reads the 15-bit low size and optional high-size word when the low word's 0x8000 flag is set.

currentImplementation.behavior: readDwgClassStringFooter reconstructs the high-bit string-stream size with bounds and cursor rollback. readDwgClasses applies the extended CLASSES prefix only when the application-maintenance gate requires it, and derives the CRC position from the corresponding prefix length.
currentImplementation.relevantExistingCommit: 1393c374 Fix extended AC1024 CLASSES CRC offset

validation.physicalCommand: For each sample, run build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf <input> -y -d -v2010 <temporary-output.dxf>; inspect DWG read observations and trace through dwgReader24::readDwgClasses.
validation.physicalResult: All 9/9 samples report operationSucceeded=true and legacyError=0 after the class stage. The five application-maintenance-version-2 files all pass. Some final CLI conversions stop later at strict opaque-output qualification; that is not a class-stage result.

fixturePolicy: All source DWGs are existing local research files outside the repository. No fixtures were added or committed.
limitations: This recheck covers the nine currently available local AC1024 samples, not every AutoCAD 2010 producer/save variant.
It does not qualify strict output or whole-file DWG/DXF support.
No production code changed because the reported class-stage failure was not reproducible in the current tree.
next: Treat this specific local class failure as resolved in the current tree. Reopen only if a new hash-bound AC1024 input reaches BAD_READ_CLASSES or fails the focused high-size footer control.
